lines: A throbbing headache, a rolling spring, a choking tetanus.
I see a shining dream, only to wake and realize it’s a nightmare.
How ready, everything will eventually decay.
A first take, burnt and pitch black.
A snake that turns to bone and starts laughing.
How many, a high price attached to people’s prayers.
A boy crushed underfoot, crying.
A president singing with a despicable mask.
Disappear right now, disappear, disappear, disappear.
Disappear, disappear, disappear, disappear.
Fresh blood glitters as Steinway and Suns bounce.
A shattered backbeat that won’t stop ringing in my head.
A scene that fades in a tenth of a second, and it’s already over.
What’s the matter? It’s not hell, so don’t look at me like that.
My reflection on the screen, a mistletoe branch piercing my back.
I keep dreaming repeatedly; even when I wake, it’s still a dream.
How ready, a refrain that drives my body to move.
The MacGuffin remains lost.
The chilled glitter at the corner of my eyes flashes.
How many, demagogy that deliberately spews smoke.
A boy trembling with anger.
The groin pain that intensifies day by day.
Disappear right now, disappear, disappear, disappear.
Disappear, disappear, disappear, disappear.
Fresh blood glitters as Steinway and Suns bounce.
I won’t stop, go forever; my vision is red‑out.
A scene that fades in a tenth of a second, and it’s already over.
What’s the matter? It’s not hell, so don’t look at me like that.
Open your sense of pain and run forward with all your soul now.
With countless feelings, just eight bars remain until the fanfare.
Ripping through the flicker, now I carve out my heart.
What’s the matter? It’s not a demon, so don’t stare at me like that.
